name: get
description:
Get full documentation for a specific Astryx (XDS) component, doc topic, or template by name.

Returns complete props, usage guidelines, code examples, and theming info.

For doc topics, optionally pass a section name to get just that section (recommended for large topics like "theme" to avoid context overload).

Examples:
- get("Button") → full Button docs with all props and examples
- get("useToast") → hook docs with usage pattern
- get("theme", { section: "defineTheme" }) → just the defineTheme API
- get("settings") → template source code
- get("Table") → full Table docs including sorting/selection hooks

name.description: Component name (e.g. "Button", "useToast"), doc topic (e.g. "theme", "spacing"), or template slug (e.g. "settings").

section.description: For doc topics: return only this section (case-insensitive substring match). Recommended for large topics.
